note: Common dhikr phrases for the tasbih counter. Arabic only, with a transliteration; no meaning, virtue or reward text is written by the app. Where the bundled hadith dataset has a hadith that names the phrase, its id is given so the app can show that hadith verbatim.

phrases.arabic: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
phrases.translit: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
